changes.comment: localize(site, name, data, locale) gives an entry or a singleton in one locale, with the fallback of each localized field. renderRichText takes a link option that gives each link its address, for example in the page's locale. localesOf(site, name, data) gives the locales that an entry is in: the default locale, and each locale where it has its own values, for getStaticPaths, lists, the sitemap and hreflang.
